title: At a desk
topic: Choosing an expression for a depicted speaker
levelRationale: Select a simple polite request appropriate to the given person and intention; structural draft with no generated picture or audio.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 絵と音声で、話す人を確かめてください。答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Use the picture and audio to identify the speaker. Choose one answer.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: となりの人のえんぴつを借りたいです。何と言いますか。
turns.translation: You want to borrow the other person's pencil. What do you say?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 2。えんぴつを貸してください。
turns.translation: Two. Please lend me a pencil.

options.label: えんぴつをどうぞ。
options.rationale: This offers a pencil rather than requesting one.

options.label: えんぴつを貸してください。
options.rationale: This asks the other person to lend a pencil.

options.label: えんぴつはありません。
options.rationale: This states absence instead of making the requested polite request.

explanation: The indicated person wants to borrow something; 貸してください asks the other person to lend it.

visual.description: Two people sit next to one another at a desk. An arrow identifies the speaking person; the other person's pencil lies beside that person's notebook. No speech bubbles or selected response.
